sources.title: Impella RP System with the Automated Impella Controller — Instructions for Use & Clinical Reference Manual (United States only)
sources.verification_note: Supplied 2026-07-27, 134 pages. Covers the RIGHT-side pump and its Automated Impella Controller. Left-side pumps are covered by the CP and 5.5 manuals registered below, supplied the same day.

sources.title: Impella CP with SmartAssist — Instructions for Use & Clinical Reference Manual (United States only)
sources.verification_note: Supplied 2026-07-27, 285 pages. Indicated for cardiogenic shock and high-risk PCI. Labeled maximum MEAN flow 3.7 L/min (Table 9.15, p272; narrative p26); peak flow at systole up to 4.3 L/min at P-9 (p77); study-observed average during support 3.8 +/- 0.6 L/min (p165). Speed range 0-46,000 rpm. These three distinct figures are why conflict.mcs.impella-cp-flow was rewritten around the measurand rather than around one number.

sources.title: Impella 5.5 with SmartAssist with Relocated Sidearm — Instructions for Use & Clinical Reference Manual
sources.verification_note: Supplied 2026-07-27, 261 pages. Indicated for cardiogenic shock. Labeled maximum flow 5.5 L/min (p250; narrative p21) - internally consistent, unlike the CP figures. Documents the Automated Impella Controller home screen and its operating parameters.

sources.title: CARDIOSAVE Hybrid Operating Instructions
sources.publisher: Datascope Corp. / MAQUET Cardiovascular LLC, Mahwah NJ USA
sources.verification_note: Supplied 2026-07-27, 214 pages. This is the full Operating Instructions that the quick-reference guides defer to, and it is the AUTHORITATIVE source for what the Cardiosave console displays. Section 1.2 Monitor Display covers ECG waveform, trigger rate, arterial pressure waveform and parameter, balloon pressure waveform, augmentation parameter, message display area, and icons/indicators; 1.3 covers the keys, 1.9 the default and user settings, and section 2 the Auto and Semi Auto operation modes with ECG and arterial pressure acquisition. REVISION TENSION TO RESOLVE: this is the Hybrid variant with a 2015 copyright, while the separately supplied quick reference covers software D.00/D.01 and is non-US. Confirm which software generation the module should model before authoring the display profile.

sources.title: IAB Insertion / Cardiosave IABP Operation Quick Reference Guide, software D.00/D.01
sources.verification_note: Supplied 2026-07-27, 60 pages. ABBREVIATED, and marked FOR USE OUTSIDE THE US ONLY. Superseded as a display source by the Cardiosave Hybrid Operating Instructions registered above; retain only for insertion workflow, and never as the source of a US device-behavior claim.

sources.title: Cardiosave IABP Troubleshooting Strategies (eLearning program booklet)
sources.verification_note: Supplied 2026-07-27, 36 pages, US. Manufacturer eLearning covering alarm conditions, ECG and arterial pressure signal troubleshooting, and triggering issues - it maps directly onto the MCS IABP failure taxonomy. EVIDENCE CLASS: training material, not labeling. Use it for teaching framing and to enumerate failure modes; the Operating Instructions remains the authority for any claim about what the device does or displays.

sources.title: The IABP Numbers Game (eLearning program booklet)
sources.verification_note: Supplied 2026-07-27, 20 pages. Manufacturer eLearning on IABP waveform characteristics and, centrally, how IABP-reported pressures differ from non-invasive and bedside-monitor pressures. That distinction is this module's own spine expressed for the IABP, so this is useful teaching framing. EVIDENCE CLASS: training material, not labeling - it must not become a load-bearing source for a numeric claim.

sources.title: IAB Insertion / CS300 Operation Quick Reference Guide
sources.verification_note: Supplied 2026-07-27, 36 pages. DIFFERENT DEVICE: this covers the CS300, not the Cardiosave the module models, and it is itself abbreviated. Registered for completeness and read for orientation only - do not source any Cardiosave claim from it. Same handling the ventilation work gave the later-generation HAMILTON-C6 marketing sheet.
